scenes.hook: Satan is a hungry dog circling your faith
scenes.speaker: Sheikh Abdur-Razzaq al-Badr · Arabic audio

cues.text: Ibn al-Qayyim, may Allah have mercy on him, gave an example
to explain Satan's relationship with a human being,
a parable that makes it clear.
He says: Satan and the human are like
a man holding a piece of meat.
That piece of meat is faith.
In front of him, all around him, is a hungry dog
circling him from every side,
waiting for the slightest slip
from the owner of the meat, to snatch it away.
That is Satan's way: circling the human from every side,
sitting in wait on every road,
as our Prophet ﷺ said:
"Satan sits in wait for the son of Adam on every path."
As some of the early scholars said: an enemy who sees you while you can't see him, a heavy burden.
But this heavy burden
becomes light with a strong bond with Allah and remembering Him.
For the remembrance of Allah is a strong fortress against the accursed Satan.
"Indeed, My servants, no authority do you have over them."
The servant who remembers Allah and takes refuge in Him,
Satan has no way over him.
